title: On the Independence of Association Bias and Empirical Fairness in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring association bias (representational bias) using Log Probability Bias Score (LPBS) and WEAT variants to calculate associations between gender pronouns ('he'/'she') and stereotyped occupation words, and evaluating empirical fairness by measuring performance disparities (precision and mean reciprocal rank) on masked word prediction cloze tests across binary gender groups.
